content.subject: Quick thought on month‑end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
you wrote that you’re shaping finance strategy in the Global FinTech Q&A. Month‑end close often stalls when reconciliation relies on manual matching across systems. Our platform reads transaction feeds and aligns entries to eliminate manual matching. Would you be open to a 20‑minute conversation early next week to see if this fits?
Zamp
